expected_effect: Make an accepted visual contract, production-state workshop, deterministic Playwright evidence and an independent visual critic mandatory before the site experience can pass.

operations.value: Turn an accepted visual contract into a browser-verified, independently critiqued interface.

value.input_outcome: Concept art, product truth and target user tasks.
value.output_outcome: A digest-bound visual contract, state inventory and viewport matrix.
value.purpose: Turn an approved concept into exact visual, responsive, motion and state constraints.

value.output_outcome: An operator decision bound to the exact contract digest.
value.purpose: Accept or reject the exact visual contract as a separate human decision.

value.input_outcome: An accepted visual contract and production component boundaries.
value.output_outcome: A local workshop covering normal, long-copy, loading, empty, error and stale states.
value.purpose: Expose real production components in every consequential state.

value.input_outcome: Accepted visual contract, content, Atlas data and workshop fixtures.
value.output_outcome: A pinned responsive bilingual frontend candidate.
value.purpose: Build the site and Atlas from the accepted visual contract and production components.

value.input_outcome: Accepted visual contract and supported browser matrix.
value.output_outcome: A pinned Playwright and axe harness with immutable approved baselines.
value.purpose: Keep deterministic browser, layout, accessibility and visual-regression checks exact.

value.input_outcome: A pinned candidate, visual contract, harness and approved baselines.
value.output_outcome: A deterministic report with screenshots, diffs, geometry, accessibility and runtime evidence.
value.purpose: Measure the exact candidate across locale, viewport, zoom, motion and browser states.

value.input_outcome: Exact concept, candidate, browser report and screenshots.
value.output_outcome: An independent pass, revise or indeterminate visual and comprehension verdict.
value.purpose: Independently reject candidates that pass mechanics but miss the accepted concept.

failure_modes: Visual baselines may be accepted from an already broken candidate.
Browser dependencies may increase repository maintenance cost.
risk.rollback: Reject v9 and retain active v8.

signals.summary: Committed and deployed pages passed string-based gates while headings, controls and Atlas panels visibly overlapped.
The Atlas preserved colors and texture but lost the accepted concept's immersive parent-current-inspector composition.
